hero.heading: Give your AI agents real-world location skills
hero.sub: HERE Location Reasoning is an MCP server that gives AI agents live geocoding, routing, traffic, place search and map rendering as tool calls, so they work from real location data instead of guessing.
hero.prompt: Find EV charging stations along my route from Berlin to Munich.

connect.heading: Connect your agent in three steps
connect.sub: Point any MCP client at the HERE Location Reasoning server, sign in, and ask a location question.

steps.title: Add the server
steps.body: Add `https://hlr.here.ai/mcp` to your client’s MCP config, or install the Kiro Power.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.body: Sign in with your HERE account in the browser, or pass a HERE bearer token from your own app.

steps.title: Ask a location question
steps.body: Try: "Find EV charging stations along my route from Berlin to Munich." Check the tool calls in the trace.

items.q: Which MCP clients work with HERE Location Reasoning?
items.a: Any LLM or agent framework that supports MCP. The docs include examples for the MCP SDKs, LangChain, Strands Agents and PydanticAI, and it is available as a Kiro Power.
Sign in with your browser when your client connects, or pass a HERE bearer token from your own application in the Authorization header.
Geocoding, routing (including EV charging and rest stops), public transit, place and EV charger search, real-time traffic, isolines and map rendering. The tools reference lists the exact tool names.

items.q: How do I pay for production use?
items.a: Subscribe on AWS Marketplace and pay as you go, or add it to Kiro as a Power. For an enterprise evaluation, explore HLR with our team.

items.q: How is it different from the HERE documentation MCP?
items.a: The documentation MCP helps your agent write HERE code. HERE Location Reasoning gives your agent live location tools while it runs. Many teams use both.
